# Pilot Testing And Iteration

Use this instruction when preparing or running early pilots.

## Core Focus

- Select 3-5 coaches who are willing to test the product in realistic conditions.
- Guide the first onboardings manually when needed.
- Record technical issues and missing capabilities discovered in the pilot.
- Iterate on questionnaire wording and logic based on observed friction.
- Prioritize and fix critical pilot bugs quickly.
- Document effective patterns for configuring tools.

## Checklist

- [ ] Select the pilot coaches.
- [ ] Run guided onboarding for the first pilots.
- [ ] Collect technical problems and product gaps.
- [ ] Iterate on questionnaire wording and logic.
- [ ] Resolve critical pilot bugs.
- [ ] Document best practices for tool configuration.

## Output Expectations

- Treat pilot insight as product input, not just QA noise.
- Distinguish between coach confusion, missing features, and implementation bugs.
- Convert recurring pilot issues into concrete roadmap updates.
